SELECT s.School,
       sat.AvgScrWrite,
       s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT s.`School` AS `School Name`, s.`Website` AS `Website`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
ORDER BY s.`School`

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC, County
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY School, ClosedDate
SELECT School, Phone, Ext FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T1
      WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    ROUND(`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / NULLIF(`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0), 4) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` LIKE '%Continuation%'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
  AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT s.School AS `School Name`,
       s.FundingType AS `Funding Type`
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sc.rtype = 'S'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sc.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY Longitude DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total_enrolled
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT f.`Low Grade`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND CAST(s.NCESDist AS INTEGER) = 613360

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.City AS city,
       TRIM(s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1) AS administrator_name
FROM schools s
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.CharterNum = '00D2'
  AND s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT s.School,
       s.City,
       TRIM(s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2)
FROM schools s
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.CharterNum = '00D2'
  AND s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT s.School,
       s.City,
       TRIM(s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3)
FROM schools s
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.CharterNum = '00D2'
  AND s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT f.`District Code`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT (s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1) AS full_name
FROM satscores AS sc
JOIN schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sc.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS customer_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(FundingType) AS ratio_percentage
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT s.AdmLName1 AS AdministratorLastName, s.District, s.County, s.School
FROM schools s
WHERE CAST(s.CharterNum AS INTEGER) = 40

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_closed_district_community_day_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND SOCType = 'District Community Day Schools'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM (
    SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 12
      AND a.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31'
) t

    SELECT MAX(amount)
    FROM (
        SELECT l.amount

        JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE l.duration > 12

    )
)

SELECT first_name, district, COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
) AS combined_admins
WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY name_count DESC
LIMIT 2

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100.0 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT district.A2 AS district_name, SUM(trans.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE trans.type = 'VYDAJ'

ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC

FROM `order` AS o
JOIN account AS a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(district_id)
FROM district
WHERE A11 > 6000 AND A11 < 10000

FROM disp d

SELECT d.A3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS classic_card_count

JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id

SELECT d.A2 AS district

JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'

SELECT t.*

      FROM disp di

  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disposition_count
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

    (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)

JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.client_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

SELECT D.A2
FROM district AS D
INNER JOIN client AS C ON D.district_id = C.district_id
WHERE C.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY D.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(C.client_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date LIKE '1998%' AND T2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' GROUP BY T1.account_id HAVING SUM(T2.amount) < ( SELECT AVG(T3.amount) FROM trans AS T3 WHERE T3.date LIKE '1998%' AND T3.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' )

SELECT l.amount AS debt_amount, l.status AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id

FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp d
      WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id
        AND d.client_id = 617
  )

SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id AS ID, c.district_id AS district
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b

JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count

        SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '-'
    ) sb ON m.molecule_id = sb.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'
  AND LOWER(di.A3) = 'east bohemia'
ORDER BY c.client_id

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
  AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_2_5'

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
    ) THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AND bond_type = '-') * 1.0 /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')) AS avg_single_bonds_per_atom

SELECT 
    (SELECT bond_type 
     FROM bond 
     WHERE molecule_id = 'TR018' 
     GROUP BY bond_type 
     ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS most_common_bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR018') = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'

SELECT (SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100.0) / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='
)
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR001'
  AND c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC, a.element ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.molecule_id, b.bond_type
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR050'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id, b.bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12')

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY element

SELECT DISTINCT atom_id
FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
    FROM connected c
    WHERE c.atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR181')
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
    FROM connected c
    WHERE c.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR181')
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'i' OR a2.element = 'i'

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c
  ON a1.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
JOIN atom a2
  ON a2.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'
  AND a2.atom_id <> a1.atom_id

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element)) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR
           (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
) AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_double_bond_molecules,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
LEFT JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(a.atom_id), 0),
        0
    ) AS percent
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 's'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '
)

SELECT 
    a.element AS element1,
    b.element AS element2,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom b ON c.atom_id2 = b.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element, b.element
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected co ON a.atom_id = co.atom_id OR a.atom_id = co.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON co.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '='

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND a.element = 'o'
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId = cardKingdomId AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion = '2015'
  AND edhrecRank < 100
SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
      AND a.element = 'h'
)

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid

JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS driver_count
FROM results
WHERE raceId = 18

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND lt.milliseconds < 120000

SELECT r.year,
       AVG(CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 +
           CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1,
                       instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
           CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
       ) AS avg_champion_time_seconds
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT r.name
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY res.rank ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
  AND lt.lap = 3
  AND lt.milliseconds = (
      SELECT MAX(lt2.milliseconds)
      FROM lapTimes lt2
      JOIN races r2 ON lt2.raceId = r2.raceId
      WHERE r2.name = 'French Grand Prix'
        AND lt2.lap = 3
  )

SELECT results.fastestLap
FROM results
INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year = 2009
ORDER BY results.time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race, l.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes l
JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE l.lap = 1
  AND l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Spanish'
  AND d.dob < '1982-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY MAX(lt.time) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT location, country, lat, lng
FROM circuits
WHERE name = 'Hungaroring'

SELECT AVG(r.points) AS average_score
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix'

SELECT r.year
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY res.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name AS racetrack,
       c.location || ', ' || c.country AS full_location
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM races)

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, res.time
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1

SELECT raceId
FROM results
WHERE time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY raceId
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(
    CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
    + CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
) AS avg_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2006
  AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix'
  AND r."rank" BETWEEN 1 AND 10

SELECT time
FROM lapTimes
ORDER BY milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultId) AS wins
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId AND r.positionOrder = 1
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MIN(dob) FROM drivers)
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(pa.penalties) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM "Match" m
JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT lt.time AS lap_record
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT lapTimes.position
FROM lapTimes
JOIN drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY lapTimes.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name, p.player_api_id
FROM Player AS p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.max_crossing DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT wins 
FROM driverStandings 
ORDER BY points DESC 
LIMIT 90, 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND strftime('%Y', m.date) = '2009'
  AND strftime('%m', m.date) = '04'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 170
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015'

SELECT t.team_long_name AS team, MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS build_up_play_speed
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY build_up_play_speed DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND ta.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'

SELECT MIN(pa.date)
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
      JOIN Player AS p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
   OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.team_long_name FROM Team_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND T1.date LIKE '2014-%' AND T1.chanceCreationPassing < ( SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND date LIKE '2014-%' ) ORDER BY T1.chanceCreationPassing DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
ORDER BY p.player_name
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN "Match" m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
    m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
    m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
    m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
    m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium'

SELECT COUNT(M.home_team_goal) AS home_team_goals
FROM `Match` AS M
JOIN Player AS P ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_2 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_3 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_4 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_5 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_6 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_7 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_8 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_9 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_10 = P.player_api_id OR M.home_player_11 = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - datetime(birthday) > 34

SELECT SUM(T1.away_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T2.player_api_id IN (T1.away_player_1, T1.away_player_2, T1.away_player_3, T1.away_player_4, T1.away_player_5, T1.away_player_6, T1.away_player_7, T1.away_player_8, T1.away_player_9, T1.away_player_10, T1.away_player_11) WHERE T2.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goals
FROM "Match" m
JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id
WHERE (julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365 <= 30

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
    m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
    m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
    m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
    m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_api_id
FROM Player p
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
      AND pa.preferred_foot = 'right'
)
ORDER BY p.player_api_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT e.`Symptoms`, e.`Diagnosis`
FROM `Examination` e
JOIN `Patient` p ON e.`ID` = p.`ID`
WHERE p.`Birthday` = (
    SELECT MIN(p2.`Birthday`)
    FROM `Patient` p2
    JOIN `Examination` e2 ON p2.`ID` = e2.`ID`
)

SELECT pa.finishing AS finishing_rate,
       pa.curve AS curve_score
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_api_id = (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY weight DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
  Player p
INNER JOIN 
  Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.`T-BIL` > 2.0

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT `Description`, `Diagnosis` FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473

SELECT AVG(1991 - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.Date) = '1997'
  AND (l.TP <= 6 OR l.TP >= 8.5)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID
    HAVING CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1
) AS sub

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND Description >= '1997-01-01'
  AND Description < '1998-01-01'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT CAST(julianday(MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) - julianday(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298

SELECT DISTINCT
    L.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%'

SELECT CASE WHEN T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 THEN 'within normal range' ELSE 'not within normal range' END AS "albumin" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_ua_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
)
  AND (
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
  )
SELECT T1.SEX, T2.UA FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 57266 AND (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA > 8.0 OR T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5)

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.UA > 6.5 THEN p.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'

SELECT AVG(p.height) AS average_height
FROM Player p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
      AND p.player_api_id IN (
          m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
          m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
          m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
          m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
          m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
          m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
      )
)

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory)

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT p.ID AS Patient_ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
ORDER BY l.`Date` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.ID, l.GLU
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GLU < 180
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Description) AS INTEGER) >= 1991

SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS REAL) / COUNT(p.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250
) lab ON p.ID = lab.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (l.WBC <= 3.5 OR l.WBC >= 9.0)
)
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.Birthday DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450)

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.PT >= 14
  )

SELECT DISTINCT e.`Diagnosis`
FROM `Patient` AS p
INNER JOIN `Examination` AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
INNER JOIN `Laboratory` AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.`Birthday`) >= '1995'
  AND l.`RA` IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) AS lower_than_normal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_normal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.RNP IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date LIKE '1984%'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS percentage
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid AND fd.language = 'French'
WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP NOT IN ('+-', '-')
  AND CAST(l.CRP AS REAL) >= 1.0
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 18

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SM NOT IN ('-', '+-')
)
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l
  ON e.ID = l.ID
 AND e.`Examination Date` = l.Date
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.APTT IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.SSB IN ('0', 'negative')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND p.SEX = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event e
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM attendance a
    WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  ) > 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS large_tshirt_count
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Human Development and Family Studies'
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Large'

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ID
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('-', '+-')
)
ORDER BY p.`First Date`
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.ALB > 3.5 AND l.ALB < 5.5
  AND l.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT e.expense_id, e.expense_description, e.expense_date, e.cost, m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya'
      AND m.last_name = 'Mclean'
      AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
)

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, income.source
FROM income
INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
ORDER BY income.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM event WHERE location = 'MU 215'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT b.category
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = 0

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PO Box' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS po_box_percentage
FROM zip_code
SELECT DISTINCT county FROM zip_code WHERE type = 'PO Box'

SELECT
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN p.ID END) * 1.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(ym.Consumption) < 30000
) AS kam_customers

SELECT s.month, SUM(s.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID, Consumption, substr(Date, 6, 2) AS month
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
) s
JOIN customers c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
GROUP BY s.month
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    b.category AS expense_type,
    SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY b.category

SELECT b.category, b.amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
ORDER BY b.amount ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT Country,
       SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(Segment) = 'value for money' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_for_money_count
FROM gasstations
GROUP BY Country
ORDER BY value_for_money_count DESC

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(e.cost) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS percentage
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.type = 'Game'

SELECT GasStationID, SUM(Amount * Price) AS Revenue
FROM transactions_1k
GROUP BY GasStationID
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Description
FROM products p
JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    c.Segment,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
     NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Percentage_Increase
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(t.Amount * t.Price), 0) AS total_spent_at_gas_stations,
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN REPLACE(CAST(t.Date AS TEXT), '-', '') LIKE '201201%'
            THEN t.Amount * t.Price
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 0) AS spent_in_january_2012
FROM transactions_1k t
WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508

SELECT c.CustomerID,
       c.Currency,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    ROUND(
        (MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating END) -
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) * 100.0 /
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END),
        2
    ) AS percentage_higher
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
  AND pa.date = (SELECT MAX(pa2.date) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id)
